integrity: All formulas have an analytic proof and a standalone finite exact-arithmetic checker; finite tests cannot prove the infinite-family theorem. The cited inclusion-matrix rank lemma is prior work. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only one-particle continuous-time coherent walks with uniform cube hopping, real scalar offset, and strictly positive sinks at every vertex of one Hamming ball. No assertion about conditional normalized dynamics, disorder, missing sites, dephasing, composite trap geometries, or historical-priority certification.
title: Exact dark-space dimension for Hamming-ball absorption on hypercube quantum walks
